THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY LAW NO. 41 OF 1978 ENACTED BY THE NATIONALSTATE ASSEMBLY

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 15(1) of the Urban Development Authority Law No. 41 of 1978enacted by the National State Assembly, I, Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Megapolis and Western Developmentdo hereby this Order, vest with the Urban Development Authority with effect from today, the lands morefully described inthe Schedule hereto being vested in the Municipal Council of Dehiwala Mount Lavinia.

PATALI CHAMPIKA RANAWAKA (M. P.),Minister of Megapolis & Western Development.Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development,17th & 18th Floors,“Suhurupaya”,Sri Subuthipura Road,Battaramulla,18th January 2019.

One allotements of lands shown as Lot 3 called as Galkissawatta in Survey Plan No. 1202, prepared by LicensedSurveyor M. W. L. I. I. Peris situated in Mt. Lavinia village within the Municipal Council limits of Dehiwala - Mt.
